name: Bloodmage: Vampyr Bite resurrects a dead party member who accepts (#3994)
contract: #3994: 'Vampyr Bite doesn't work' (level 80, GM island). Vampyr Bite rank 8 803587 (level 80; ranks 803581..803587 in AscensionSpellProgressionData) is SPELL_EFFECT_RESURRECT (18) on a dead ally (Targets 0x8000), 8 s cast; effect 1 transforms the target into creature 27616 and effect 2 applies +50% healing taken for 20 s. Spell::EffectResurrect restores CountPctFromMaxHealth(damage) health and mana, stores the request and sends SMSG_RESURRECT_REQUEST; the target accepts with CMSG_RESURRECT_RESPONSE (0x15C, caster guid + u8 1). Expected: a dead, unreleased party member who accepts the request is alive afterwards. A released ghost cannot be targeted by effect 18 (Spell::CheckCast has the corpse LOS fallback only for SPELL_EFFECT_RESURRECT_NEW); that case is outside this scenario. The run decides the classification: a pass means the unreleased case already works; a fail confirms a defect in the resurrect path.
